prompt:
Generate a 16:9 landscape, pure white background illustrated guide to Qipao structure and craft details. The overall style is a modern minimalist illustration page + high-end clothing structure research drawing + New Chinese Style minimalist clothing analysis page. The image should be clean, bright, restrained, and exquisite, with a clear sense of design and sharability.

Set up a complete title explanation area at the top, with simple and high-end typography and ample white space:
Main Title: "Modern Modified Sleeveless Qipao"
Subtitle: "Illustrated Guide to Structure and Craft Details"
Top style description line: "New Chinese Minimalism | Off-white Jacquard Silk | Auspicious Cloud Hidden Flower Pattern | Off-white Base - Light Gold Piping"
Top-right series label: "New Chinese Style Series"

Background must be pure white, not off-white, not rice paper, no vintage paper texture.

In the center is an adult Oriental female, aged 22–32, with an elegant, modern, and restrained temperament. Facial features are delicate and intellectual, with soft contours and a clear Oriental aesthetic. Hairstyle is a simple low bun. The pose is natural and stable, front-facing or slight 3/4 angle, showing the full body. Arms should not block the garment structure. The focus is on displaying the Qipao, not a portrait photography.

She wears a modern modified sleeveless Qipao in New Chinese Minimalism style with a slim-fit streamlined silhouette. Specifications:
Collar: Low stand-up collar
Opening: Simplified diagonal opening
Button type: Minimalist straight frog button
Sleeve: Sleeveless
Length & Slit: Mid-calf length, medium slit
Fabric: Off-white jacquard silk
Pattern & Craft: Auspicious cloud hidden flower jacquard
Main color & Piping: Off-white base + Light Gold piping

The central Qipao must clearly show: low stand-up collar, diagonal opening line, minimalist frog buttons, sleeveless shoulder contour, waist darts, slit position, and hem piping.

Distribute 7 local breakdown modules on the left and right sides, strictly matching the central Qipao in color, fabric, pattern, piping, and structure. Focus areas: neckline, opening line, sleeveless shoulder, waist dart, slit, jacquard texture, and piping craft.

Modules mix three forms: structural enlargement (neckline, opening, shoulder, slit), craft macro view (texture, piping, buttons), and structural line drawing (waist darts).

Use fine, hand-drawn dashed unidirectional arrows with small dot anchors to connect modules to the central figure. Style: elegant and restrained, not high-tech infographic.

Label each module with brief Chinese names only: 领厘 (Neckline), 襔线 (Opening Line), 无袖肩部 (Sleeveless Shoulder), 腰省 (Waist Dart), 开衩 (Slit), 提花纹理 (Jacquard Texture), 滚边工艺 (Piping Craft).

Add small samples at the bottom: off-white jacquard silk fabric, light gold piping color swatch, minimalist frog button sample.

Overall visual emphasis: purity, modern structural feel, New Chinese Minimalism, delicate jacquard layers, high-end off-white and light gold palette, design research page feel, and sharability.

Lighting: soft and bright, like a high-end fashion design display, clearly presenting silk textures, piping thickness, and tailoring details.

Negative Constraints: No ordinary portrait poster feel, no e-commerce white background product shot feel, no messy layout, no long descriptions, no thick arrows, no technical straight lines, no blocking the garment structure, no inconsistency in details, no incorrect slit position, no blurred textures, no plastic texture.

promptZh:
生成一张 16:9 横版、纯白背景的旗袍结构与工艺细节插画指南。整体风格为现代极简插画页面 + 高端服装结构研究图 + 新中式极简服装分析页。画面需简洁、明亮、克制且精致，具有清晰的设计感与传播属性。

顶部设置完整的标题说明区，采用简约高端的排版，留白充足：
主标题：“现代改良无袖旗袍”
副标题：“结构与工艺细节图解指南”
顶部风格描述行：“新中式极简主义 | 米白色提花真丝 | 祥云暗花纹样 | 米白底色 - 浅金色滚边”
右上角系列标签：“新中式系列”

背景必须为纯白色，非米白色，非宣纸，无复古纸张纹理。

中心为一名 22–32 岁的东方女性，气质优雅、现代且克制。五官精致知性，轮廓柔和，具有鲜明的东方审美。发型为简约低发髻。姿态自然稳定，正面或微侧 3/4 角度，展示全身。手臂不得遮挡服装结构。重点在于展示旗袍，而非人像摄影。

她身着新中式极简风格的现代改良无袖旗袍，剪裁修身流畅。规格如下：
领型：低立领
开襟：简化斜襟
盘扣：极简一字盘扣
袖型：无袖
长度与开衩：小腿中部长度，中开衩
面料：米白色提花真丝
纹样与工艺：祥云暗花提花
主色与滚边：米白底色 + 浅金色滚边

中心旗袍需清晰展示：低立领、斜襟线、极简盘扣、无袖肩部轮廓、腰省、开衩位置及下摆滚边。

在左右两侧分布 7 个局部拆解模块，在颜色、面料、纹样、滚边和结构上与中心旗袍严格保持一致。重点区域：领口、开襟线、无袖肩部、腰省、开衩、提花纹理、滚边工艺。

模块结合三种形式：结构放大（领口、开襟、肩部、开衩）、工艺微距（纹理、滚边、盘扣）以及结构线条图（腰省）。

使用精细的手绘虚线单向箭头，配合小圆点锚点将模块连接至中心人物。风格：优雅克制，非科技感信息图。

每个模块仅标注简短的中文名称：领口 (Neckline)、开襟线 (Opening Line)、无袖肩部 (Sleeveless Shoulder)、腰省 (Waist Dart)、开衩 (Slit)、提花纹理 (Jacquard Texture)、滚边工艺 (Piping Craft)。

底部添加小样：米白色提花真丝面料、浅金色滚边色卡、极简盘扣样品。

整体视觉重点：纯净感、现代结构感、新中式极简主义、细腻的提花层次、高端米白与浅金配色、设计研究页质感及传播性。

光影：柔和明亮，如同高端时装设计展示，清晰呈现丝绸质感、滚边厚度及剪裁细节。

负面约束：拒绝普通人像海报感，拒绝电商白底产品图感，拒绝杂乱排版，拒绝长篇描述，拒绝粗箭头，拒绝生硬的直线，拒绝遮挡服装结构，拒绝细节不一致，拒绝错误的开衩位置，拒绝模糊纹理，拒绝塑料质感。
